name: JEP 350 - Dynamic CDS Archives
dscr: Explains how the JVM can create an application CDS archive dynamically at exit via `-XX:ArchiveClassesAtExit`.

name: JEP 351 - ZGC: Uncommit Unused Memory (Experimental)
dscr: Explains how ZGC returns unused heap memory to the operating system, configurable via `-XX:ZUncommitDelay` and `-XX:-ZUncommit`.
